sql_queries.purpose: Full Stage 4 timeline with joined verdict sinks
sql_queries.query: SELECT sa.ep_num, sa.ts, sa.session_id, sa.attempt_num, sa.attempt_key, sa.verdict AS stage_verdict, sa.initial_verdict, sa.score AS stage_score, ds.round_num, ds.verdict AS director_verdict, ds.score AS director_score, ds.pre_firewall_score, ds.firewall_triggered, ds.firewall_reason, json_extract(sa.advisory_flags, '$.gate_semantics.gate_basis') AS gate_basis, json_extract(sa.advisory_flags, '$.gate_semantics.director_verdict') AS payload_director_verdict, json_extract(sa.advisory_flags, '$.gate_semantics.final_verdict') AS payload_final_verdict, sa.fix_scope, sa.reject_reason FROM stage_attempts sa LEFT JOIN director_selections ds ON ds.stage = sa.stage AND ds.ep_num = sa.ep_num AND ds.attempt_key = sa.attempt_key WHERE sa.stage = 4 AND sa.ep_num BETWEEN 1 AND 15 ORDER BY sa.ep_num, sa.ts;

SELECT sa.ep_num, sa.ts, sa.attempt_num, sa.attempt_key, ds.verdict AS director_selections_verdict, json_extract(sa.advisory_flags, '$.gate_semantics.director_verdict') AS payload_director_verdict, json_extract(sa.advisory_flags, '$.gate_semantics.final_verdict') AS payload_final_verdict, sa.verdict AS stage_attempts_verdict, sa.score, sa.reject_reason FROM stage_attempts sa JOIN director_selections ds ON ds.stage = sa.stage AND ds.ep_num = sa.ep_num AND ds.attempt_key = sa.attempt_key WHERE sa.stage = 4 AND sa.ep_num BETWEEN 1 AND 15 AND sa.verdict = 'REJECT' AND (ds.verdict IN ('PASS', 'PASS_WITH_FIX') OR json_extract(sa.advisory_flags, '$.gate_semantics.director_verdict') IN ('PASS', 'PASS_WITH_FIX')) ORDER BY sa.ep_num, sa.ts;

SELECT ep_num, attempt_num, COUNT(*) AS row_count, GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT session_id) AS session_ids, GROUP_CONCAT(attempt_key) AS attempt_keys FROM stage_attempts WHERE stage = 4 AND ep_num BETWEEN 1 AND 15 GROUP BY ep_num, attempt_num HAVING COUNT(*) > 1 ORDER BY ep_num, attempt_num;
